title: NATS Streaming (`stan`) trigger is deprecated — removed in 2.19

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: **NATS Streaming scaler**: Deprecate NATS Streaming Server (aka Stan) (#6362)
remediation: NATS Streaming Server itself reached end-of-life in June 2023. Migrate each ScaledObject / ScaledJob named to the `nats-jetstream` trigger (JetStream consumer lag) before 2.19, where the `stan` trigger type no longer exists and the object fails to build its scalers.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select(.type == "stan") | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row is a trigger type 2.19 removes
coversNotes: docs scalers/nats-streaming.md: The Stan scaler (NATS Streaming) is DEPRECATED and will be removed…
docs scalers/nats-streaming.md: See also the deprecation notice here.

title: Apache Kafka scaler: unused `awsEndpoint` metadata key removed

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: **Apache Kafka Scaler**: Remove unused awsEndpoint in Apache Kafka scaler (#6627)
remediation: pkg/scalers/apache_kafka_scaler.go drops the `awsEndpoint` tag at v2.17.0 (the key was never used for a request); from 2.17 it is ignored on each apache-kafka trigger named. Nothing in the apache-kafka scaler reads `awsEndpoint` at 2.17 or later (the field was declared but unused at v2.16.1:73); just delete the key.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "apache-kafka") and (.metadata // {} | has("awsEndpoint"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row carries a key 2.17 ignores

title: KEDA operator: the metric names deprecated in 2.14 are removed

detection.reason: which metric names a dashboard, alert or recording rule reads is not in the collected projection

remediation: Any dashboard, alert or recording rule still reading a 2.14-deprecated name goes blank: `keda_scaler_metrics_latency` → `keda_scaler_metrics_latency_seconds`; `keda_scaler_errors` → `keda_scaler_detail_errors_total`; `keda_scaler_errors_total` → `sum(keda_scaler_detail_errors_total)`; `keda_scaled_object_errors` → `keda_scaled_object_errors_total`; `keda_scaled_job_errors` → `keda_scaled_job_errors_total`; `keda_trigger_totals` → `keda_trigger_registered_total`; `keda_resource_totals` → `keda_resource_registered_total`; `keda_internal_scale_loop_latency` → `keda_internal_scale_loop_latency_seconds`. `keda_scaler_errors_total` has no direct successor — sum `keda_scaler_detail_errors_total`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.groups[]?.rules[]?.expr | test("keda_metrics_adapter_")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a rule file whose expressions go dark on the hop

title: External scalers: `tlsCertFile` is removed from trigger metadata

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: **External Scaler**: Remove deprecated tlsCertFile from External scaler (#4549)
remediation: `tlsCertFile` was a CA trust root (v2.16.1 external_scaler.go:313, `credentials.NewClientTLSFromFile(file, "")`), not a client certificate. Put the PEM content into a TriggerAuthentication `caCert` parameter, or set `enableTLS: true` to use the system roots — with neither, 2.17 dials the external scaler in PLAINTEXT (v2.17.0:325).
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "external" or .type == "external-push") and (.metadata // {} | has("tlsCertFile"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row loses its client certificate on the hop

title: cpu / memory triggers: `type` is announced for removal in 2.18 — use `metricType`

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: name=type, order=triggerMetadata, enum=Utilization;AverageValue, optional, deprecatedAnnounce=The 'type' setting is DEPRECATED and will be removed in v2.18 - Use 'metricType' instead.
remediation: From 2.17 the operator emits a KEDAScalerInfo event on every ScaledObject / ScaledJob named ("The 'type' setting is DEPRECATED and will be removed in v2.18"). Replace `metadata.type` with the trigger-level `metricType` now; 2.18 refuses the trigger.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "cpu" or .type == "memory") and (.metadata // {} | has("type"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row is refused by the 2.18 scaler

title: IBM MQ: `tls` is announced for removal in 2.18 — use `unsafeSsl`

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: name=tls, order=triggerMetadata, default=false, deprecatedAnnounce=The 'tls' setting is DEPRECATED and will be removed in v2.18 - Use 'unsafeSsl' instead
remediation: From 2.17 the operator emits a KEDAScalerInfo event on every ibmmq trigger named. Replace `tls` with `unsafeSsl` (same meaning: skip certificate verification) now; 2.18 refuses the trigger.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "ibmmq") and (.metadata // {} | has("tls"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row is refused by the 2.18 scaler
